name: Return of Zero · Room 7 of 8 · §5 — Objective Internality
description: The philosophy is faithfully reflected in the technology: six products develop six aspects of the means through which a Life discloses and acts within a World. Six movements as addressable scenes in one shared section-room grammar. Binds to section-rooms/06-objective-internality/ at Antykathera-Essay-Work dbf3b17.

entities.name: Traversal — the three registers of the address

text.title: Central
text.body: What is carried must remain answerable to what arrives.

text.title: Actuation
text.body: A weighted field collapses into one act.

entities.name: Traversal — the predicates climbed in order

text.title: Potency
text.body: Exists is not yet operative; the ladder is climbed.

text.title: Transformation
text.body: Intention meets resistance and returns changed.

entities.name: Traversal — the attempt crossing the field
the host here — bright and concrete
the source there — real and dim

text.title: Situated existence
text.body: Every act is somewhere, and the somewhere answers.

text.title: Transcendent relation
text.body: The whole differentiates and does not cease to be whole.
